Apply: https://digitalmehmet.com/contact & https://illumination-curated.comFollow publicationTop highlightMember-only storyExploring the Zodiac: Personality Traits and Preferences of Each Astrology SignA fun guide to the astrology signs favoritesShana YoungFollow7 min read·Oct 19, 20233104ListenSharePress enter or click to view image in full sizePhoto by Josh Rangel on Unsplash- horoscope chartI’ve always been interested in astrology and love reading horoscopes. I thought it would be fun to compile a list of favorites based on each astrological sign. As an Aries, mine is not too far off. Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments!Astrology has long fascinated humanity, offering insights into our personalities and preferences based on the positions of celestial bodies at the time of our birth. While not everyone swears by the zodiac, many find it an interesting way to gain self-awareness and explore their tastes. In this article, we’ll delve into the personality traits and favorite choices of each astrology sign, from Aries to Pisces.Aries (March 21 — April 19): Personality: Aries individuals are known for their boldness and enthusiasm.
